program_text: program 11 CIS - Computer Sci and Info Systems Applied Artificial Intelligence COA_Applied Artificial Intelligence Go Back Print Certificate of Achievement (COA) Applied Artificial Intelligence New Online Option Noncredit New for Spring 2026 Program Description Pending state approval. Please check with the CTE Division Office for status. The Certificate of Achievement in Applied Artificial Intelligence (AI) explores the foundational concepts of AI through theory discussions and hands-on beginning-level applications. The certificate is designed for those with limited programming, math and statistics background. The series of courses in the certificate will introduce students to the core methodologies and techniques in AI, introductory-level AI applications, emerging trends and ethical considerations. Program Learning Outcomes Upon completion, students will be able to Discuss artificial intelligence (AI) core concepts and explain the fundamentals of AI applications Design and utilize effective prompts for Large Language Models, which includes understanding and usage of major prompt patterns, Retrieval Augmented Generation, AI agent and customized GPT Evaluate, design and implement responsible and ethical AI solutions with transparency and accountability De Anza College Requirements Noncredit Certificate Requirements Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a C grade, passing grade or satisfactory progress Each course must be completed at De Anza College Skills Certificate Requirements Skills Certificates are awarded by departments and are not notated on official college transcripts. Contact the department directly for assistance in applying for a skills certificate. Completion of all major courses with a C grade or higher Each course must be completed at De Anza College Certificate of Achievement Requirements Certificates of Achievement are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. No more than six quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements Certificates of Achievement-Advanced are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. Students must demonstrate proficiency in English and Mathematics by qualifying for ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H or ESL 5, and by qualifying for MATH 114 or a transfer-level Math course No more than 18 quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements See Cal-GETC pattern found at deanza.edu/articulation/ge-requirements . Note: This is an exception to the Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements. The requirements are stated within the description. Associate Degrees (A.A. or A.S.) Requirements Proficiencies Students must demonstrate proficiency in reading, written expression and mathematics.
